prompt: Create ONE original finished raster cursor concept based on the reference's quiet dark-fantasy materials, real dimensional shading, restrained ivory/steel edge light and deep soft shadow. The reference is only for material and lighting, REMOVE its sword, slash arc and scene entirely. Render the specified small tangible object, not a flat logo, outline glyph, SVG drawing or diagram. Diagonal orientation: precise sharp working tip at upper left, body extends to lower right. Strong asymmetric readable silhouette suitable for a 40px mouse cursor. Occupy about 75% of the square canvas with clear margin; isolated on completely uniform dark neutral grey background, no cast shadow on background, no gradients or scenery. No text, labels, borders, glitter, dramatic glow, gold or pervasive gritty stone texture. Keep substantial readable forms rather than tiny filigree. Object: a compact gothic spearhead shaped like the pinnacle of a tower, tapered steel point, dark recessed central rib and two modest inward-curving architectural shoulders. Three-dimensional forged steel, broad cold silver plane catching light and dark opposite plane; short socket at lower right. This must read as a solid forged spearhead, not an arrow pictogram or full-size spear.
